message.text:
q06.

**`memo_relation`**

It's a join table keyed on `(memo_id, related_memo_id, type)`, so the same pair can be linked under different relation types (e.g. reference vs. comment):

```47:52:store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql
CREATE TABLE memo_relation (
  memo_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  related_memo_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  type TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(memo_id, related_memo_id, type)
);
```

The same definition appears in `store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql` (line 46) and the MySQL schema, and it was introduced in `store/migration/sqlite/0.13/00__memo_relation.sql`. Access code lives in `store/memo_relation.go` with per-dialect implementations such as `store/db/postgres/memo_relation.go`.
